items.caption: A received seal-script form of 歌, presented in the Shuowen style. The dictionary analyzes this form as 欠 with 哥 supplying the sound.
items.alt: Seal-script style glyph identified as 歌, with the form’s components arranged as 欠 and 哥.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the received analysis of 歌. This modern redraw does not establish the character’s earliest form or the relationship between the reported 言+可 and 欠+哥 structures.
